newsitem.title: UK: Murdoch's $1.0 bln-plus share issue delayed - paper.
newsitem.headline: Murdoch's $1.0 bln-plus share issue delayed - paper.

text.p: Media mogul Rupert Murdoch's News America Holdings is to delay its expected convertible share issue of one billion dollars or more by at least a week, according to unnamed sources close to the group's banks, The Independent newspaper said in a report on Monday.

The sources told the paper that the issue, to be converted into shares in British Sky Broadcasting Group Plc, would not be priced this week in order to wait for the BSkyB satellite broadcaster to present its quarterly profits due Friday.
The inside source said the issue was not being pulled and that there had been "considerable interest" from big investors.
